'''Andrew Roberts''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2000 Sea Girt tournament]] on 1 July 2000 with [[Rescue The Princess / Sometimes I Amaze Even Myself|Rescue the Princess]], according to Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d964">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-7-1-seagirt-nj-and-7-2-clarks-sum-pad964/ 7-1-seagirt-nj-and-7-2-clarks-sum-pa], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 2 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-02-7-1-seagirt-nj-and-7-2-clarks-sum-pad964/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
